text.arabic_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ

words.gloss_range: corrective particle that escalates beyond the prior defeat rather than merely adding a new item

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the known Hour named by the corrective clause

words.prose: {{ar:بَلِ}} ({{tr:bali}}) makes the ayah begin as a correction and escalation, not as a simple continuation. It keeps the rout of 54:45 in view, but demotes it as the final horizon and launches the listener into {{ar:ٱلسَّاعَةُ}} ({{tr:al-sāʿatu}}) as the real appointment. Its light final vowel also carries the particle directly into the next definite noun, so the correction sounds joined to the Hour rather than isolated.

topics.headline: correction beyond the prior defeat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears that the defeat in 54:45 is not denied, but displaced by the Hour as the decisive reckoning.
topics.reason: The clause evidence forces a corrective nominal clause after {{ar:بَلِ}} ({{tr:bali}}), and the boundary rows identify 54:45 as the proposition being demoted.

topics.headline: connected launch into the Hour
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the correction is carried straight into the named Hour rather than stopping as a detached objection.
topics.reason: The final kasra and clause launch support a smooth discourse connection while remaining within the particle's corrective role.

words.gloss_range: the known eschatological Hour, with the time-unit sense still pressing as a decisive appointed threshold
words.root_gloss_range: time/hour branch is locally active; unrelated branches such as neglect, idol-name, clay, fluid, or destroyed-group are not selected here
words.prose: The first {{ar:ٱلسَّاعَةُ}} ({{tr:al-sāʿatu}}) is the subject of a verbless identity clause: the Hour itself is named before the predicate says it is their appointment. Its definiteness points to the recognized eschatological Hour, while the time-word still makes that reckoning feel like a fixed threshold. Because the same noun opened the surah's warning in 54:1, its return here ties the closing correction back to the opening nearness of the Hour.

topics.headline: the Hour as the first clause subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the ayah identifies the Hour as their appointment instead of treating the Hour as an object or background time.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the word as a definite nominative subject with {{ar:مَوْعِدُهُمْ}} ({{tr:mawʿiduhum}}) as predicate.

topics.headline: moment and eschaton compressed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the tension between a bounded time-word and the enormous final reckoning it names.
topics.reason: The time/hour branch supports the threshold pressure, while the definite eschatological usage and local appointment frame block unrelated root branches.

topics.headline: return to the Hour of 54:1
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears 54:46 as closing a surah-local arc: the Hour that drew near in 54:1 is now assigned as their appointment.
topics.reason: The attachment cross-reference explicitly links this definite noun to the Hour frame introduced in 54:1.

topics.headline: first half of a repeated Hour
topics.reader_payoff: The reader anticipates that the repeated full noun will do more than maintain reference; it will let the second clause reload the same Hour with severity.
topics.reason: Word 2 and word 5 repeat the same definite noun in parallel nominal clauses, so the first occurrence participates in an intra-ayah reprise.

words.gloss_range: their fixed appointment, deadline, or rendezvous, sharpened toward threat-fulfillment by the prior boast and rout
words.root_gloss_range: promise, threat, and appointed time/place are relevant; reciprocal or animal-bellow branches remain background only
words.prose: {{ar:مَوْعِدُهُمْ}} ({{tr:mawʿiduhum}}) completes the first nominal clause by making the Hour their appointed time, not merely a circumstance around another event. The suffix binds the appointment to the group carried over from 54:45, so the word turns their projected strength into a fixed deadline. The {{ar:و ع د}} ({{tr:w-ʿ-d}}) field keeps promise, threat, and appointment together: this is a scheduled meeting whose force has become threatening, while the mafʿil form leaves both time and rendezvous pressure available. Supplied appointed-time parallels such as 3:9, 18:48, and 34:30 support that formulaic background, but the local suffix keeps this appointment fastened to them.

topics.headline: appointment as the predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the appointment as the identity predicated of the Hour, not as a loose adverbial time.
topics.reason: The word is nominative predicate of the first nominal clause, completing the equation with {{ar:ٱلسَّاعَةُ}} ({{tr:al-sāʿatu}}).

topics.headline: their appointment, not an abstract appointment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the plural group from 54:45 into the appointment word itself.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence resolves the suffix to the prior group and marks it as the possessive complement of the construct noun.

topics.headline: promise and threat inside the appointment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the appointment is not neutral scheduling; it is promise-fulfillment turned against the boastful group.
topics.reason: The local word selects appointed time/place, while the boundary context and root family legitimately sharpen the appointment toward threat-fulfillment.

topics.headline: time and rendezvous pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses the Hour as both the when and the unavoidable meeting-point of their reckoning.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a noun of time/place and the V4 appointment branch supports both temporal and locative appointment senses.

topics.headline: Quranic appointed-time field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears this compact phrase as part of a broader Quranic appointed-time formula while still tied locally to this group.
topics.reason: The bundle supplies appointed-time parallels such as 3:9, 18:48, and 34:30; they support formulaic background but do not override the local suffix and predicate role.

words.gloss_range: medial conjunction linking the completed appointment clause to a second characterization clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the repeated subject introduced after the medial connector

words.prose: The medial {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) turns a completed appointment statement into a second characterization statement. It can be heard as coordination, resumption, or circumstantial linkage, but the shared payoff is local: the ayah moves from what the Hour is for them to what the Hour is like. Its sound flows into the repeated {{ar:ٱلسَّاعَةُ}} ({{tr:al-sāʿatu}}), so the second clause feels cumulative rather than detached.

topics.headline: hinge from identity to quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah pivot from naming the Hour as their appointment to evaluating its severity.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence shows two nominal clauses linked by this particle, with the second clause adding predicates of severity.

topics.headline: coordination with circumstantial shading
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can keep both possibilities in view: the second clause is a fresh assertion and also characterizes the state of that appointment.
topics.reason: The second clause is syntactically complete, so the circumstantial reading is a shading of the link rather than a replacement for coordination or resumption.

words.gloss_range: the same known Hour, repeated as the subject of a second nominal clause for severity characterization
words.root_gloss_range: time/hour and eschatological Hour remain locally active; unrelated root branches are not selected

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the first comparative predicate of the repeated Hour
the second comparative predicate of the repeated Hour

words.prose: The second {{ar:ٱلسَّاعَةُ}} ({{tr:al-sāʿatu}}) refuses pronominal reduction. The ayah repeats the full definite noun so the listener re-encounters the Hour before hearing the double predicate {{ar:أَدْهَىٰ}} ({{tr:adhā}}) and {{ar:أَمَرُّ}} ({{tr:amarru}}). The repetition changes the predicational load: first the Hour is their appointment, then the same Hour is characterized as more calamitous and more bitter, deepening the 54:1 Hour thread at the climactic evaluation.

topics.headline: full noun repeated before predicates
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the Hour reinstalled as a full subject before the severity pair, not merely carried by an implicit pronoun.
topics.reason: The second clause repeats the full definite nominative subject and makes it govern both comparative predicates.

topics.headline: same Hour, new predicational load
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees repetition serving development: the same word shifts from appointment identity to qualitative judgment.
topics.reason: The repeated noun has the same referent but a different predicate frame, moving from {{ar:مَوْعِدُهُمْ}} ({{tr:mawʿiduhum}}) to two elative qualities.

topics.headline: hammering return of the Hour
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a doubled local echo that also tightens the surah's opening Hour reference from 54:1.
topics.reason: The bundle links the word to both the repeated noun inside 54:46 and the Hour frame introduced in 54:1.

words.gloss_range: more calamitous, more devastating, with a narrowed coloring of precise or penetrating calamity
words.root_gloss_range: calamity-befalling branch is locally selected; shrewdness/precision can color the force, while size-only branch is not active

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the second comparative predicate paired with this word

words.prose: {{ar:أَدْهَىٰ}} ({{tr:adhā}}) is the first elative predicate of the repeated Hour. It leaves the comparison standard unstated, so the Hour surpasses the prior rout and the whole punishment field rather than one named benchmark. The selected sense is catastrophic befalling, while the root's shrewdness branch narrows into a payoff of precise, target-reaching calamity. As a Quranic root hapax in this form, it makes the Hour's severity lexically singular; its open final contour also lets the pair move from expansive calamity into the harsher felt bitterness of {{ar:أَمَرُّ}} ({{tr:amarru}}).

topics.headline: open comparative predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the Hour measured beyond an unstated comparison field, not merely described as severe.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the word as an elative predicate of {{ar:ٱلسَّاعَةُ}} ({{tr:al-sāʿatu}}), and no comparison complement is supplied.

topics.headline: calamity that reaches its target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices not only scale but a calamity that comes upon its target with penetrating precision.
topics.reason: The calamity branch is locally selected by the severity predicate; shrewdness remains as a qualifying pressure of precision, not an independent claim that the Hour is clever.

topics.headline: singular Quranic severity word
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that this severity word is not normalized by other Quranic occurrences; its force is concentrated here.
topics.reason: The contextual profiles mark the exact root/form as a single occurrence, matching the CRITICAL hapax claim.

topics.headline: first half of the severity pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears an ordered movement from expansive calamity to the harsher final bitterness of {{ar:أَمَرُّ}} ({{tr:amarru}}).
topics.reason: The local pair is structurally supported; sound-symbolic claims are kept as cadence and contrast, not as independent proof of meaning.

words.gloss_range: conjunction coordinating the two comparative predicates as simultaneous qualities of the Hour

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the first comparative predicate coordinated by this particle
the second comparative predicate coordinated by this particle

words.prose: The second {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) prevents the two comparatives from collapsing into one vague severity label. It coordinates {{ar:أَدْهَىٰ}} ({{tr:adhā}}) and {{ar:أَمَرُّ}} ({{tr:amarru}}) as co-predicates of the same Hour: objective calamity and felt bitterness stand together. The tiny connector also gives the phrase a hinge beat, carrying the listener from overwhelming impact into acrid experience.

topics.headline: two predicates kept parallel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the Hour is both more calamitous and more bitter, not one quality replacing or modifying the other.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates {{ar:أَمَرُّ}} ({{tr:amarru}}) with {{ar:أَدْهَىٰ}} ({{tr:adhā}}) as another predicate quality of the Hour.

topics.headline: beat from impact to experience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a small rhythmic pivot from the Hour's destructive impact to how bitter it feels.
topics.reason: The particle both separates and binds the adjacent elatives, making the two-part severity cadence audible.

words.gloss_range: more bitter, harsher in felt experience, with narrowed pressures of passage, persistence, and tightened roughness
words.root_gloss_range: bitterness and bitter hardship are locally selected; passing/continuing and twisted-rope branches can color the experience, while unrelated innards or bile branches are not active

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the repeated Hour inherited as the subject of this predicate

words.prose: {{ar:أَمَرُّ}} ({{tr:amarru}}) closes the ayah as the second coordinated elative predicate of the Hour. It does not start a new clause; it inherits {{ar:ٱلسَّاعَةُ}} ({{tr:al-sāʿatu}}) and leaves the comparison standard open, making the Hour more bitter than the preceding field can measure. The local sense selects bitterness and bitter hardship, while passage, persistence, and tightened-rope imagery narrow into color for a suffering that comes through them and grips. Supplied echoes with appointment and continuity contexts, including 18:48, 54:2, and 54:19, make this final bitterness answer the scheduled meeting without changing its local predicate sense. In final position, the geminated ending makes bitterness the last semantic and acoustic landing.

topics.headline: second open comparative predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears bitterness as a formal judgment on the Hour, open-ended in comparison and parallel to {{ar:أَدْهَىٰ}} ({{tr:adhā}}).
topics.reason: The word is a coordinated elative predicate of {{ar:ٱلسَّاعَةُ}} ({{tr:al-sāʿatu}}), with no explicit comparison complement.

topics.headline: bitterness as felt suffering
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the severity become sensory and acrid rather than only abstractly intense.
topics.reason: The bitterness and bitter-hardship branches are selected by the local elative; passing, persistence, and twisted-rope branches can color the experience but do not replace the bitterness sense.

topics.headline: bitter ending of the appointment field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the final bitterness to the appointment logic and to same-surah continuity language without letting those echoes override the local predicate.
topics.reason: Rows connect the word with appointment contexts such as 18:48 and same-surah forms at 54:2 and 54:19; these are echo/provenance supports, not alternate local senses.

topics.headline: completion of the double characterization
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the pair divide the work: {{ar:أَدْهَىٰ}} ({{tr:adhā}}) names catastrophic impact, while {{ar:أَمَرُّ}} ({{tr:amarru}}) names the felt bitterness.
topics.reason: The local coordination makes the two elatives one predicate pair while preserving their different root domains.

topics.headline: bitter final landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears bitterness as the ayah's final landing, reinforced by the compressed geminated close.
topics.reason: The word is final in the ayah and has a geminate ending; sound claims are retained as acoustic reinforcement of the already selected bitterness sense.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled hour, predicated as their موعد and comparatively intensified by أدهى and أمر.
baseline_models.mechanism: A bounded rendezvous turns an announced future into their assigned encounter; calamity and sensory bitterness make the second mention an escalation from date to experienced event.

activation_trace.role: A promise bounded by time or place makes the موعد a fixed rendezvous.
An affliction that arrives disastrously supplies the escalation carried by أدهى.
Literal bitterness makes أمر an ordeal to be experienced rather than only ranked.

changed_reading.before: The Hour is simply a future judgment more severe than worldly defeat.
changed_reading.after: The Hour is their fixed rendezvous, and its second naming opens the date into a calamitous, tasted encounter.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: موعدهم stands between the two occurrences of the hour, while أمر also carries temporal occurrence and repetition.
baseline_models.mechanism: The split mapping of موعد activates enumeration and fixed recurrence: the doubled hour is not vague futurity but an already counted threshold whose occurrence has been set.

activation_trace.role: Enumeration makes the appointment a counted threshold rather than an indefinite future.
A fixed time that returns in known intervals reinforces temporal determination.
Occurrence in a portion of time lets the repeated hour press as a definite happening.

changed_reading.before: The appointment is a generally promised future.
changed_reading.after: The doubled hour marks an enumerated temporal threshold whose occurrence is already fixed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated الساعة is joined to موعدهم and followed by an adjective whose root can denote passage.
baseline_models.mechanism: A distant hour-branch evokes neglected, directionless going; the fixed appointment arrests that drift and turns passing onward into an imposed bitter passage.

activation_trace.role: Unattended going supplies an exploratory image of the addressees drifting without direction.
The bounded rendezvous functions as the point that arrests the drift.
Passing and traversal convert loose movement into an unavoidable passage through the event.

changed_reading.before: The Hour is only an external deadline awaiting them.
changed_reading.after: The Hour also names the limit at which their ungoverned going is seized and made into an unavoidable passage.

context_deltas.mechanism: The free-going echo in the hour is no longer neutral drift: culpable severance, loss of direction, and ignition or fevered motion form a self-intensifying circuit that terminates at the appointment.

activation_trace.role: Unattended going provides the focus-side image that the next ayah darkens.
Severe adversity anchors the resulting circuit back in the comparative أمر.
Cutting and severance give the agents' culpability a functional break from right direction.
A lost thing left to waste turns drift into unrecoverable disorientation.
Ignition makes the disoriented state actively consuming.
Fevered madness adds an inward loss of governance to the outward loss of way.

structural_cues: 54:47 immediately replaces the doubled hour's comparative description with the criminals' paired state of ضلال and سعر.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies severance, lost direction, ignition, and fevered madness; I infer that disorientation feeds a burning circuit already continuous with the Hour. A live alternative is that 54:47 merely lists two static punishments.

changed_reading.before: The Hour externally stops an otherwise neutral wandering.
changed_reading.after: Their culpable severance has become a lost, fevered motion whose ignition is already the experiential form of the approaching Hour.

context_deltas.mechanism: Dragging fixes the body face-first toward the fire, while tasting and contact turn the focus ayah's comparative bitterness and calamity into an imposed sensory sequence.

activation_trace.role: Disastrous affliction supplies the focus-side event that the next ayah bodily specifies.
Tasteable bitterness prepares the shift from comparison to direct sensation.
Dragging and extension supply the coercive motion into the encounter.
The face as the body's forward aspect makes exposure immediate and orientation inescapable.
Experiential tasting converts the bitter adjective into undergone knowledge.
Contact that leaves an effect closes the sequence as consequential touch.

structural_cues: 54:48 opens with يوم, temporally unpacking the preceding hour, then moves through passive dragging to the imperative ذوقوا and the contact noun مس.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forced motion, frontal exposure, experiential tasting, and consequential contact; I infer that forced contact is how the abstract comparatives become embodied. The alternative is that the comparatives remain rhetorical while 54:48 starts an independent scene.

changed_reading.before: More calamitous and bitter are general intensifiers.
changed_reading.after: The Hour is more calamitous because it takes bodily control, and more bitter because its truth is learned through forced, face-first contact.

context_deltas.mechanism: The appointment's focus-side counting is nested inside created measure: its limit is not an improvised reprisal but a calibrated boundary within an ordered whole.

activation_trace.role: Counting supplies the focus-side idea of an enumerated موعد.
A bounded time or place supplies the concrete appointment that receives the measure.
Measuring a thing in its formation makes calibration prior to the event.
A quantity reaching its proper limit defines the appointment as an exact boundary.
Deliberate ordering supplies governance behind the appointed limit.

structural_cues: The universal كل شيء follows the bodily judgment scene without changing speaker, expanding from their appointed event to the measure of every thing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies formation by measure, exact limit, and deliberate ordering; I infer that the same order governs موعدهم. A live alternative is that 54:49 states general ontology without specifically explaining the appointment.

changed_reading.before: Their موعد is a date imposed after the course of history.
changed_reading.after: Their موعد is a calibrated limit internal to a measured creation, so its severity is exact rather than impulsive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fixed موعد crosses from promise to actuality without procedural delay: one effective command collapses the interval as quickly as a flash registered by sight.

activation_trace.role: The bounded appointment supplies the event whose execution is now specified.

structural_cues: 54:50's restriction construction joins أمرنا, واحدة, and كلمح بالبصر into a single compressed execution statement.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies destruction, counterpart relation, counting-with-another, and recurrence; I infer that analogy makes their appointment an instance of a repeatable rule. The alternative is that prior peoples serve only as moral reminder.

changed_reading.before: Their appointment is an isolated future assigned only to the present group.
changed_reading.after: Their appointment is the next counted occurrence in a demonstrated pattern that has already reached comparable groups.

context_deltas.mechanism: The counted موعد becomes the closure point of a complete ledger: enacted deeds are gathered into writing, and scale cannot remove an item from the ordered line.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enacted units, writing, total inclusion, and ordered lines; I infer that the record is complete before the appointment and is opened there as an accounting boundary. The alternative is that the record only attests events after judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing contrast reveals that bitterness is relationally scoped: protection leads to a stable place where promise is fulfilled in nearness to effective sovereignty, while their موعد is the adverse encounter.

structural_cues: The pronoun in موعدهم scopes the bitter appointment to its group, while 54:54-55 replaces being in disorientation and burning with being in gardens and a stable seat.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protection, stable sitting, fulfilled promise, nearness, sovereignty, and effective capacity; I infer that the Hour sorts relationally distinct appointments rather than imposing one undifferentiated experience. The alternative is that the reward scene is adjacent but does not revise the scope of 54:46.

strongest_changes: 54:48 converts the focus comparatives into forced bodily motion, tasting, and consequential contact.
54:49-50 places the fixed appointment inside exact measure and instantaneous single-command execution.
54:51-53 makes the appointment recurrent across comparable cohorts and the closure point of an exhaustive record.
54:54-55 scopes bitterness to their encounter by revealing a protected, stable, fulfilled counterpart.
summary.what_was_special: The sequence repeatedly changes the kind of event named by the focus ayah: date becomes bodily process, measured limit, executable command, historical recurrence, ledger closure, and finally one side of differentiated appointments. Distant focus branches preserve secondary images of drift, destruction, tightening, and crossing without replacing the ordinary syntax.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal link from universal measure to this specific موعد is strong contextually but remains reader-supplied.
The counting and swimming split mappings may be productive activations or form-distant noise.
The record may precede the appointment as its accounting basis or merely attest deeds once the appointment arrives.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The appointed encounter exceeds the nearer military reversal.** The packet has no hour/time branch for `س و ع`, so that form is anchored lexically only at root level; `و ع د` B003 explicitly supplies an appointed time or place, and `د ه ي` B001 being struck by what harms or dismays. `بَلِ` redirects attention from the group’s coming defeat to its appointment. I infer an escalation from a historical rout to a more dismaying fixed encounter. The ayah reads the defeat as provisional evidence, not the full terminus.

2. **`أَمَرُّ` preserves bitterness and severe calamity.** `م ر ر` B003 is bitter taste and B004 bitter severity/calamity. Later 54:48 commands `ذُوقُوا۟`, making taste a concrete experiential channel, while the surrounding threats support severity. I infer that the comparative can mean both more bitter to experience and more severe in consequence. The sensory and evaluative readings reinforce but remain distinct.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 54:48 commands tasting the touch of Saqar, directly activating `م ر ر` B003’s bitter-taste image inside `أَمَرُّ`. What first reads evaluatively as “more severe” acquires a concrete sensory mechanism.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **`و ع د / B003` (an appointed time or place), carrying `B002` (a threat directed toward harm).** `مَوْعِدُهُمْ` displaces the near battlefield defeat with a fixed larger appointment. The packet supplies immediate rout and a later appointment; I infer local defeat -> is not the terminal threatened settlement. **Reading change:** `بَلِ` expands the scale from one broken collective to its definitive scheduled encounter.
2. **`م ر ر / B003` (bitter taste) with `B004` (bitter severity or calamity).** The comparative `أَمَرُّ` precedes faces dragged into fire and the command to taste in 54:48. The packet supplies comparative bitterness and later embodied fire contact; I infer the appointed encounter -> culminates in experienced bitterness. **Reading change:** the Hour's severity is rendered gustatory and bodily, not only quantitative.
3. **`د ه ي / B001` (being struck by what harms or dismays), beside `B002` (shrewdness that hits its aim).** The group's concerted strategy fails in 54:44-45; `أَدْهَى` names an encounter that defeats strategic comprehension as well as force. The packet supplies human plan and larger appointment; I infer shrewdness at the event-side -> outmaneuvers human shrewdness. **Reading change:** the Hour is more confounding because it reaches its aim despite their collective calculation.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 54:48 made أمر bitter in a literal experiential register through taste, touch, and fire; 54:49-50 then corrected apparent chaos by locating the event inside measure and unitary command.

Bu nedenle geçici çerçeve doğrudur; ancak dal yalnızca soyut zaman akışı değildir ve yapıya bağlı zaman, işlem, kiralama ve güçlük kullanımları ayrı tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, tek taraflı temel bildirimi ad ve eylem biçimleriyle kapsar; iyilik bildiren özel kuruluş yalnızca kendi bağlamında ayrı bir uzmanlaşmadır.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, insanın veya başka bir canlının su içinde yüzerek ilerlemesidir.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin istediği sonuca ulaşmasını sağlayan ince hesaplı kurnazlık, keskin kavrayış ve sağlam görüştür. Bu niteliğe sahip kişi ve onun gibi davranma biçimi, çekirdek beceriye bağlı kullanımlardır.

Türemiş eylem kullanımı, bu niteliğe sahip kimselerin yaptığı gibi davranmayı belirtir.
Başka türemiş kullanımlar, kişiyi bu nitelikle ilişkilendirir veya onda bu niteliğin bulunduğunu bildirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyin ilerleyip gitmesini veya bir yerden geçmesini çekirdek anlam olarak verir; birini bir yol üzerinden geçirmek ve bir şeyin kendi yolu üzerinde sürmesi bunun yapıya bağlı gerçekleşimleridir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin ilerleyip gitmesi, bir yerin yanından ya da üzerinden geçmesi veya yolunu izleyerek sürmesidir. Yapıya bağlı kullanımda bir kimseyi belirli bir yol üzerinden götürüp geçirmeyi de anlatır.

Ettirgen yapıda bir kişi belirli bir yolun, örneğin bir köprünün, üzerinden geçirilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ilerleme, gitme ve bir şeyin yanından ya da üzerinden geçme çekirdeğinde birleşir; ayrıca sürme ve birini belirli bir yol üzerinden geçirme kullanımları da aynı iddia içinde yer alır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tatlılığın ve hoş tadın karşıtı olan duyusal tadı, ayrıca yiyeceğin bu tada dönüşmesini açıkça dalın merkezi yapar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın tat niteliğini, bir şeyin bu tadı edinmesini ve bu niteliğe bağlı adlandırmaları ayrı düzeylerde tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir yiyecek, içecek veya başka tadılabilir şeyde tatlılığın ve hoş tadın karşıtı olan keskin, sevimsiz tadın bulunmasıdır. Bir şeyin bu tadı sonradan edinmesi de aynı dalın süreç kullanımıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı kötülük, ağır sıkıntı ve büyük yıkım olarak doğrular; yoksulluk ve yaşlılığı örnekler. Geçici çerçevedeki kaygı ile hastalık bu dal iddiasında yer almadığından kavram tanımına taşınmamıştır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ipi sıkıca burma işlemini, ortaya çıkan ince ve uzun sıkı burulmuş ipi ve ipin tek tek burulmuş kollarını aynı somut yapıda birleştirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal ipin burulma işlemi ve burulmuş yapısıyla sınırlıdır; insan gücü ve kararlılık yalnız ayrı dalda benzetmeli uzantıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, ipi sıkıca burma kalıbını, burulmuş ipin adlarını ve ipin tek kolunu birbirine karıştırmadan birlikte gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Bir ipin kollarını birbirine sıkıca burarak sağlam bir ip oluşturma işlemi ve bu işlemle ortaya çıkan sıkı burulmuş iptir. İpi oluşturan tek bir burulmuş kol da bu yapının parçası olarak adlandırılır.

facets.statement: İpin kolları sıkıca birbirine burularak sağlam bir bütün oluşturulur.
İnce, uzun ve sıkı burulmuş ipin kendisi işlemin sonucu olarak adlandırılır.
İpi meydana getiren tek bir burulmuş kol, bütün yapının kurucu parçasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar sıkı burmayı çekirdek işlem sayar; burulmuş ipin kendisini, sıkı burulma derecesini ve ipi oluşturan tek kolları bu işlemden türeyen görünümler olarak verir.

Kararlılığa kişinin kendine saygısını ve onurlu direncini koruması eşlik eder.

concept_map.definition: Eski beden anlayışında bedeni oluşturan sıvılardan biri sayılan acı sıvı, bunun kişide baskınlaşmasıyla açıklanan hastalık durumu ve bu sıvıyı taşıdığı düşünülen öd kesesidir.

facets.statement: Eski beden anlayışında acı bir sıvı, bedeni oluşturan temel sıvılardan biri sayılır.
Bu sıvının kişide baskınlaşması bir hastalık veya bozulmuş beden durumu sayılır.
Hayvan bedenindeki öd kesesi, söz konusu acı sıvıyı taşıyan organ olarak adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar eski tıpta bedeni oluşturan acı sıvıyı, bu sıvının baskınlığından doğan hastalık durumunu ve hayvandaki öd kesesini aynı fizyolojik çerçevede toplar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Bu dal, kanıtta tek üretken kök çekirdeğine indirgenmeyen sınırlı adlandırma malzemesini taşır. Yapısal bölme şartı koşmadan, yalnız verilen biçim ve bağlam sınırı içinde kontrollü adlandırma kümesi olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kayıt genel kök anlamı gibi genişletilmemeli, içindeki öğeler birbirinin yerine geçen tek bir sözlük karşılığı sayılmamalı ve yalnız kanıtın verdiği adlandırma sınırı içinde kullanılmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kapsam verilen biçim, adlandırma veya özel kullanım sınırıyla bağlıdır; ortak bir yalın anlam ya da üretken genel kullanım varsayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Kanıt iki bağımsız anlam taşır: dışkının toplandığı bağırsaklar ve iki acı huy. Bunlar tek bir üst kavram altında birleşmediğinden dalın veya ilgili sözlük biriminin ayrıştırılması gerekir.

facets.statement: Bir ad, dışkının toplandığı bağırsakları belirtir.
Ayrı bir ad, bağırsaklarla ilgisiz biçimde iki acı huyu belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, tek bir birleşik anlamdan çok sınırlı veya biçime bağlı adlandırmaları gösterir; dal bu kayıtları kontrollü biçimde görünür tutar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bu karşılık, kanıttaki sınırlı veya biçime bağlı adlandırma kümesini güvenli biçimde etiketler; tek ve birleşik bir sözlük anlamı değildir.

error_profile.preserves: Dalın özel, yalıtık veya biçime bağlı adlandırma niteliğini korur.
